observations.behavior: Adds a new CLI argument `--no-release-bind` to the `dsym upload` command, allowing the CLI to omit the release ID from the uploaded dSYM chunks while still creating the release metadata.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog CLI users to upload dSYM symbol sets without binding them to a specific release, potentially supporting a release-independent ingestion or recovery workflow.

observations.behavior: Computes a release-independent chunk release ID, setting it to None when `--no-release-bind` is used, otherwise cloning the release ID.
